us.h: New U.S. tariffs on 14 economies draw pushback
us.s: China, Japan and other partners objected after Washington proposed Section 301 tariffs over industrial overcapacity, including 20% on China and up to 15% on Japan, likely starting early 2027.

us.h: Trump demands probe after GDP revised up to 4.3%
us.s: Trump claimed without evidence that pre-midterm growth data was deliberately understated after the BEA raised third-quarter GDP growth from 3.4% to 4.3%. The agency cited more complete spending and investment data.

us.h: Trump tells troops Iran war victory is near
us.s: In Thanksgiving calls to service members at Gulf bases, Trump said victory over Iran would come when he chose, offered Tehran a chance to negotiate and downplayed Chinese and Russian help to Iran.

us.h: Storm dumps record snow on St. Louis, outages linger
us.s: St. Louis got 7.3 inches, its second-snowiest Thanksgiving, and Memphis saw rare holiday snow. Over 160,000 lost power in Missouri and Illinois, and high-tide coastal flooding and slick roads remain possible Friday.

us.h: EPA finds no airborne lead after Iowa Army blast
us.s: After the Army detonated its whole lead azide stockpile at an Iowa ammunition plant, EPA air monitors found no airborne lead. Soil, water and dust lab results are still pending.

world.h: Drone attack in Kuwait kills two Italian contractors; Iran denies role
world.s: Two Rheinmetall Italia technicians servicing an air-defence system died from debris of intercepted drones. Italy and Kuwait blame Iran, which calls it a false flag and offers a joint probe.

world.h: Trump says he pressed Putin to pull back in Europe
world.s: Trump says he urged Putin to halt aggression across Europe and hopes for a fast Ukraine deal; meanwhile Russian missiles wounded seven in Kyiv and Zelenskyy warned of another mass strike.

world.h: New Zealand's ruling coalition falls one seat short
world.s: Final results give Luxon's three-party bloc 65 of 130 seats, leaving the centrist Opportunity Party's seven MPs as potential kingmakers; failure to strike a deal could force a new election.
The military rulers who seized power a year ago pushed the December 6 presidential and legislative votes back two years, citing lack of resources, despite ECOWAS calls for a swift civilian return.

tech.h: SAP reportedly weighing at least 10,000 job cuts
tech.s: Per Bloomberg's sources, SAP is planning cuts of roughly 9% of staff, focused on engineering, development and sales, as it reorganizes around AI. SAP says no decisions have been made.

tech.h: ChatGPT users will hit GPT-6.2 limits sooner after fix
tech.s: OpenAI admitted a launch error had undercounted GPT-6.2 usage; after correcting it, the same work burns allowance up to 40% faster. Paid users get one banked reset, no back-charges.

tech.h: US curbs delay next Chinese AI models into 2027
tech.s: Sources say Z.AI's GLM-5.5 and Moonshot's next Kimi model may slip months as new US limits on overseas compute access and labs' anti-distillation safeguards bite.

tech.h: Germany and Austria push for European-owned TikTok
tech.s: The two governments want TikTok's EU business and its recommendation algorithm placed under European control, and will seek EU backing at a December 2 ministers' meeting. TikTok calls the idea meritless.

tech.h: Musk, SpaceX pledge two shares per US child
tech.s: SpaceX and Musk doubled their pledge to put two SpaceX shares in every American child's Trump Account, about $18 billion in total; parents must claim the account to activate it.

talking.h: Bears stun Lions on last-second TD, take NFC North lead
talking.s: Caleb Williams hit Rome Odunze for the winning score as Chicago won 39-35 in Detroit, ending the Lions' six-game win streak despite 205 rushing yards from Jahmyr Gibbs.

talking.h: Eagles erase 21-point deficit to beat Cowboys 39-38
talking.s: With Jalen Hurts out, backup Joe Milton threw two long touchdowns to DeVonta Smith, and Jake Elliott won it with a 59-yard field goal with two seconds left in Dallas.

talking.h: Bills top Chiefs 13-10 on 57-yard walk-off kick
talking.s: Tyler Bass won a rain- and wind-swept Thanksgiving night game in Orchard Park as time expired, pushing Buffalo to 10-1, the AFC's best record, and dropping Kansas City to 8-3.

talking.h: Black Friday lines return as shoppers head to stores
talking.s: Lines formed at a Chicago-area outlet mall at the 6 a.m. opening. An ICSC survey found 84% of weekend shoppers plan to visit physical stores, the highest share since 2019.

coming.h: Senate returns facing shutdown, Iran war funding fight
coming.s: Senators come back from Thanksgiving with under two weeks to fund the government. A short-term stopgap into early next year looks likely, with Democrats pushing for limits on Iran war funding.

coming.h: Cyber Monday forecast to top $15 billion online
coming.s: Adobe expects $15.1 billion in U.S. online sales on Cyber Monday, up 6.2%, keeping it the year's biggest online shopping day.

coming.h: Supreme Court hears AR-15 ban challenge
coming.s: The justices hear arguments on whether Cook County, Illinois' ban on AR-15s and similar semiautomatic rifles violates the Second Amendment. The case is now called Khaya v. Cook County.

coming.h: Chiefs visit Rams on Thursday Night Football
coming.s: Kansas City, now 8-3 after losing in Buffalo, plays at the Los Angeles Rams.
The Labor Department releases the November employment report at 8:30 a.m. ET. October job openings (JOLTS) data comes out Tuesday, Dec. 1.
